::::

:::: {.column width="40%"}
::: {style="font-size: 75%;"}
- **i2b2** is **I**nformatics for **I**ntegrating **B**iology & the
  **B**edside Cohort Discovery System
- i2b2 is an NIH-funded National Center for Biomedical Computing (NCBC)
  based at Partners’ HealthCare System in Boston
- Enables investigators to **identify potential study cohorts** using
  clinical data resources
- Intended for protocol development for grant or IRB submission
- Provides access to curated data through a web client
- Returns **only patient counts**
:::
::::

::::::::

## Feasibility and Cohort Discovery

- **How many** men with hypertension diagnoses had at least one
  inpatient encounter between January and December 2018?​
- **How many** women ages 45-65 had successful breast cancer surgery?​
- **How many** children were diagnosed with diabetes and had Hemoglobin
  A1c greater than 7% in the same financial encounter?​

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Data Availability in i2b2

- **i2b2 data guide**​
  - Go to UF Health IDR i2b2 training page
    [`here`](https://idr.ufhealth.org/research-services/feasibility-cohort-discovery/uf-health-i2b2-training-tools/)​

  - Click on
    [`The i2b2 Data Guide`](https://idr.ufhealth.org/wordpress/files/2021/09/DataGuide_2021_August.pdf)
- Data is refreshed quarterly, starting June 2011​
- Data is represented as closely as possible to the original source​ in
  the i2b2 Common Data Model

------------------------------------------------------------------------
